Hello,

Thanks for booking Fix-It Saturday on Saturday 12 June. The library's lift is out of service, so we've moved to Room A on the ground floor, which is step-free. Same time: 10:30am to 1pm.

Room A is smaller. The library will confirm your place by Friday evening; if we can't fit you in, we'll offer you a place on 10 July or 14 August.

New from June: we can't accept lithium power tool batteries over 36 V.

Questions: Millbrook Library events desk, 555-0100.
